inspection.method: Read-only source inspection and CPU state-dict comparison; no inference or training launched.
inspection.forward_path: HatchFinder.forward calls drawing_encoder(drawing, mask), _get_vectors(drawing_features, hatch), then output_comparison and heatmap_decoder. HatchEncoder.forward and DrawingEncoder.forward apply their blocks and return feature tensors. No detach(), no_grad(), or inference_mode() wraps either encoder forward path. The package's no_grad occurrence is in a visualization path, outside model forward.
inspection.gradient_path_assessment: Installed forward and encoder code preserve autograd from output through both encoders; source inspection does not show a gradient-detach blocker.

conclusion: Both encoder submodules changed in the pilot checkpoint, with almost every encoder parameter differing from the base weights. This confirms actual encoder weight updates, in addition to the source-level gradient path. The small maximum differences are compatible with a short low-learning-rate pilot and do not establish a useful validation improvement.
